Independent producer B review of the frozen full dossier and held original/actor source texts. The original makes the 10 USC2808 invocation available immediately under the EO12722 Iraq emergency. EO12722 and EO12724 precede EO12734, so missing machine target provisions for those actors cannot establish a later cessation of this order. EO12771 expressly leaves the Iraq emergency unaffected. The original has one operative construction invocation plus effective/publication implementation. It invokes 10 USC2808 according to its terms, for Defense and military department Secretaries, and contains no finite project, report, fixed expiration, or separate independent program. EO13350 explicitly revokes EO12734 and terminates its underlying emergency; section 10 makes that action effective July 30, 2004 at 12:01 a.m. EDT, not July 29 signing. The military department discretion is part of the single construction authority. Immediate commencement and transmission/publication implement that invocation and do not create separate continuing construction authority after emergency termination. No performance or congressional transmission date is asserted. EO13350 section 1 preserves pending actions, pre-effective-date proceedings, matured rights/duties and penalties under NEA202(a). Such accrued effects are retained; it does not save a prospective EO12734 construction delegation or transfer it to the new Iraq emergency. Its property-blocking continuation is expressly limited to EO12722/12724. Selected OFR later-order search is bounded to its reported catalog/saved-text scope; the eCFR search reaches2026-10-14. USC119-121 is only current through2026-10-09 and is not asserted as a complete cutoff predicate. No human approval or publication is asserted.
